soa_notes.text: This SoA shows visits and procedures unique to the intervention-specific appendix (ISA) H0P-MC-OA03 (OA03) for LY3556050. Please refer to master protocol CPMP and the OA DSA CPMP(1) SoAs for additional information.
Visit occurs 4 days after Visit 3 [remainder redacted in source]
Visit occurs 8 days after Visit 3 [remainder redacted in source]

Visit window +2 days
There will be 2 telephone visits between Visit 3 and Visit 4:
V3-V7: Do symptom-directed physical examination
V3, V5 and V7: Single ECG before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6 and ED: Single ECG
ECG includes collection of PR interval, QRS duration and interval, and heart rate.

Blood Pressure
Collect orthostatic blood pressure after 5 minutes supine and then 2-3 minutes after standing and collect pulse after supine and standing blood pressure.
Temperature and Respiratory rate
Collect once at each visit
V3, V5, and V7: Collect blood pressure and pulse in supine and standing position, before in-clinic dosing and at 3 hours after dosing
V4, V6 and ED: Collect blood pressure once

Intervention is taken orally, twice daily (BID), approximately every 12 hours.
Refer to Section 6.6 for dose titration scheme.
V3, V5, and V7: Participants take the morning dose in the clinic.
Performed at investigator discretion
For WOCBP only

For WOCBP only
Collect sample within 24 hours prior to first dose.
V3: Collect 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V5 and V7: Collect samples before dosing and 3 hours ±15 minutes after dosing.
V4, V6, and ED: Collect single sample at any time.
Record date and time of collection.
